article.summary_es: Christ Church International Joseph's House es una despensa de alimentos en Jamaica, Queens, que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Abre los sábados, pero solo el 2.º y el 4.º sábado del mes.
article.summary_en: Christ Church International Joseph's House is a food pantry in Jamaica, Queens, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open on Saturdays, but only on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of the month.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 122-20 Merrill St, Jamaica, New York, 11434.
La despensa solo abre el 2.º y el 4.º sábado del mes.
Puede llamar al (718) 276-2799 para preguntar qué alimentos entrega y si hay requisitos.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 122-20 Merrill St, Jamaica, New York, 11434.
It is open Saturdays from 10am to 12pm.
The pantry is only open on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of the month.
You can call (718) 276-2799 to ask about the food given and any requirements.
